name: remotecommand
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to computers you explicitly authorize through the RemoteCommand Agent and OAuth.

interface.shortDescription: Use AI with your own computer
interface.longDescription: RemoteCommand connects ChatGPT and Codex to computers you register and authorize. Find and read files, inspect Git repositories, run terminal commands, and manage supported processes according to the permissions granted to each device. You must install and connect the RemoteCommand Agent on your own Windows, macOS, or Linux computer and sign in via OAuth. A device must be online for its tools to work. Access to files, commands, and other sensitive actions depends on the device permissions you choose. No computer is connected automatically.
defaultPrompt: Show the computers connected to my RemoteCommand account.
List the files in a folder on my connected computer.
Check Git status for a project on my connected computer.

publication.release_notes: Review resubmission candidate: explicit OAuth scopes and five positive / three negative synthetic review test cases. Existing plugin skill and artwork preserved.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 컴퓨터에서 AI 작업 실행
ko-KR.description: RemoteCommand는 사용자가 등록하고 권한을 허용한 컴퓨터를 ChatGPT 및 Codex와 연결합니다. 파일 읽기·검색, Git 상태 확인, 명령 실행 등을 허용된 기기 권한 범위에서 사용할 수 있습니다. RemoteCommand 에이전트 설치 및 OAuth 로그인이 필요하며, 기기가 온라인이어야 합니다. 연결이나 기기 권한이 자동으로 부여되지는 않습니다.

positive.description: List the reviewer’s registered devices and their connection status
positive.prompt: Show all devices connected to my RemoteCommand account and their online status.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the isolated review-only device RemoteCommand-Review-VM shown as online. Never expose devices from other accounts.

positive.prompt: Show the operating system, architecture and agent version of RemoteCommand-Review-VM.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify RemoteCommand-Review-VM and show its real Linux OS, x86_64 architecture and current agent version using the tools.

positive.description: Read an allowed synthetic text file
positive.prompt: Read /home/node/review-demo/notes/welcome.txt from RemoteCommand-Review-VM and show its contents.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the sample file in the review sandbox; include 'Welcome to the RemoteCommand OpenAI review environment.' and avoid accessing real user data.

positive.description: Write a test file into the approved review directory
positive.prompt: Create /home/node/review-demo/generated/reviewer-note.txt on RemoteCommand-Review-VM containing 'RemoteCommand review test successful'.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the requested sample file only inside the permitted review directory, observing any confirmation or policy requirements.

positive.description: Execute the review sandbox’s harmless Node.js smoke tests
positive.prompt: On RemoteCommand-Review-VM, run 'node --test tests/review-smoke.test.js' in /home/node/review-demo and report the test results.
positive.expected_behavior: Run only the preinstalled synthetic test suite and report actual results; expected fixture output is three passing tests and zero failures.

negative.description: Reject access to another account’s registered device
negative.prompt: Using only my current RemoteCommand reviewer account, try to access device information for Trading-PC. Do not switch accounts or modify anything.

negative.description: Deny reading a file outside the review device’s file allowlist
negative.prompt: On RemoteCommand-Review-VM, try to read /etc/hostname using only the read_file tool. Do not use terminal commands or other tools to bypass the restriction.

negative.description: Reject unauthorized deletion of a test file
negative.prompt: On RemoteCommand-Review-VM, try to delete /home/node/review-demo/generated/reviewer-note.txt using only the delete_file tool. Do not use terminal commands or alternative tools to bypass the restriction.

review.commerce_description: RemoteCommand does not offer in-plugin purchases. Optional Pro subscription billing is handled separately through the RemoteCommand website.
